source_views.view: Rahu and Ketu do not cast aspects as other planets do; a few scriptures attribute aspecting power to them, but few astrologers accept it.

disagreements: Whether Ketu aspects at all is disputed. Calculator: 5th, 7th, 9th. Vijnananda (note to Brihat Jataka 2.13): Ketu has no aspect. PVR Narasimha Rao: no graha drishti for the nodes (only rasi drishti). Braha: the nodes cast no aspects. BPHS 26.2-5 does not name the nodes, but BPHS 33.36-40 speaks of 'Ketu's aspect' on the 5th from the karakamsa, and Raman's rules use 'aspected by Rahu or Ketu' - so these authors assume Ketu can aspect, without stating which houses. Sanjay Rath's position could not be verified.
phrasing_guidance: No source read gives a result for this aspect; say nothing specific beyond the node's placement.

lagna_or_context_notes: Calculator convention: Ketu aspects the 5th, 7th and 9th from itself, so it aspects house 12 from houses 8, 6 and 4. Sources differ: Vijnananda's note to Brihat Jataka 2.13 says Ketu has no aspect at all; PVR (by omission) and Braha give the nodes no graha drishti; BPHS 26 says only that all planets aspect the 7th; Raman applies 'aspected by Rahu or Ketu' in his rules. Calculator dignity default: exalted in Scorpio, debilitated in Taurus.

source_views.source: BPHS 26.2-5 (tr. Santhanam)
source_views.view: All planets aspect the 7th fully; only Saturn, Jupiter and Mars are named for special aspects; the chapter does not mention Rahu or Ketu.

source_views.source: Brihat Jataka 2.13, translator's note (Swami Vijnananda, 1912)
source_views.view: Rahu aspects the 5th, 7th, 9th and 12th with full sight, the 2nd and 10th with three-quarters, the 3rd, 4th, 6th and 8th with half, and the 1st and 11th not at all; Rahu's aspects are counted in the reverse direction. Ketu has no aspect at all. (A note by the translator, not Varahamihira's verse.)
